notes: Named as the active ingredient of the crop protection formulations this section describes, both alone and as the substance the modification I starting material carries into the formulation. No purity is stated of tembotrione itself: the more than 98 Gew.-% figure at [0027] is the content of crystal modification I in the active ingredient quality and is recorded on that record, not here. The full IUPAC name is not spelled out in these lines, so it is not carried in aliases here.

Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity but one of the three crystal modifications the patent names. This is modification I, the stable form, named here as the form suited to the preparation of formulations and in particular suspension formulations of crop protection agents, and as starting material for tembotrione formulations generally. Also named in mixtures with modifications II and III and with other herbicides. Mentioned in several paragraphs of the section; one merged record. purity_pct 98.0 is the weight fraction of crystal modification I in the active ingredient quality, a polymorphic content lower bound and not a chemical assay: it says how much of the solid is in this crystal form, nothing about chemical purity. The section states three weaker thresholds for the same quantity, more than 20 Gew.-%, more than 90 Gew.-% and more than 95 Gew.-%, with more than 98 Gew.-% as the most preferred. No method is given, so purity_method is null.

The section prints this modification only inside the plural phrase 'den Kristallmodifikationen II und III von Tembotrione', so no alias is carried here: the singular spelling is not a literal substring of these lines.
